snippet.title: Patch 6.2 – Fury of Hellfire
snippet.description:
Patch 6.2: Fury of Hellfire arrives June 23.

Gul’dan shares his terrible vision for the future of Draenor in this Patch 6.2 overview. Learn more at http://www.WorldofWarcraft.com
